mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_sections ( id, space_id, source_document_id, section_id, parser_version, title, level, section_path, ordinal, content_text, start_offset, end_offset, content_hash, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.spaceId}, #{entity.sourceDocumentId}, #{entity.sectionId}, #{entity.parserVersion}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.level}, #{entity.sectionPath}, #{entity.ordinal}, #{entity.contentText}, #{entity.startOffset}, #{entity.endOffset}, #{entity.contentHash}, #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
